sources.snippet: What is led-large-16384? LED-Large-16384 is AllenAI's implementation of the Longformer Encoder-Decoder architecture, specifically designed to handle extremely long documents up to 16,384 tokens in length. The model is built upon the BART-large architecture and innovatively extends its position embedding capabilities by replicating the original embedding matrix 16 times.
